changeSet.author: kmarete
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_asset_catalog_dataset_id ON asset_catalog (dataset_id) WHERE dataset_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_asset_catalog_model_id ON asset_catalog (model_id) WHERE model_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_asset_catalog_workspace_id ON asset_catalog (workspace_id) WHERE workspace_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_asset_catalog_biospecimen_id ON asset_catalog (biospecimen_id) WHERE biospecimen_id IS NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE asset_catalog ADD CONSTRAINT asset_catalog_type_valid CHECK (asset_type IN ('DATASET', 'MODEL', 'WORKSPACE', 'BIOSPECIMEN'))
ALTER TABLE asset_catalog ADD CONSTRAINT asset_catalog_number_valid CHECK (asset_number >= 0)
ALTER TABLE asset_catalog ADD CONSTRAINT asset_catalog_one_reference CHECK (num_nonnulls(dataset_id, model_id, workspace_id, biospecimen_id) <= 1)

ALTER TABLE asset_catalog ADD CONSTRAINT asset_catalog_reference_type CHECK ((dataset_id IS NULL OR asset_type = 'DATASET') AND (model_id IS NULL OR asset_type = 'MODEL') AND (workspace_id IS NULL OR asset_type = 'WORKSPACE') AND (biospecimen_id IS NULL OR asset_type = 'BIOSPECIMEN'))

ALTER TABLE asset_catalog ADD CONSTRAINT asset_catalog_reference_number CHECK ((model_id IS NULL OR model_id = asset_number) AND (workspace_id IS NULL OR workspace_id = asset_number) AND (biospecimen_id IS NULL OR biospecimen_id = asset_number))
